title: P300 dataset from Hoffmann et al 2008
description: A P300 brain-computer interface dataset comprising EEG recordings from 8 subjects (4 disabled, 4 able-bodied) performing a visual oddball task with image stimuli. The dataset includes 32-channel EEG data sampled at 2048 Hz from subjects counting target images among randomly presented sequences, with applications to assistive technology and BCI performance evaluation in clinical populations.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Biosemi ActiveTwo system with 32 active electrodes at 2048 Hz sampling rate. Subjects performed a visual P300 paradigm where six images were presented in random sequences (flash duration 100 ms, inter-stimulus interval 400 ms), and subjects silently counted target image occurrences. Four sessions of six runs each were conducted per subject.
